voices.name: Open universal voice
voices.author: Linda Johnson (LibriVox) / Keith Ito (LJ Speech) - public domain
voices.description: Open universal voice: trained only from public-domain speech (LJ Speech 1.1, reader Linda Johnson, LibriVox). Free for any use, also commercial. Attribution appreciated: LJ Speech dataset, Keith Ito, https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/

Свободен для любого использования, в том числе коммерческого. Атрибуция приветствуется: набор LJ Speech, Keith Ito, https://keithito.com/LJ-Speech-Dataset/
